project_scope.product: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for explainable model selection at the development-subtask level.
project_scope.host_boundary: DSH provides the main agent, sessions, tools and native subagent orchestration. GeneralRouter does not build a separate orchestrator.
project_scope.routing_boundary: GeneralRouter maintains capability and task references, matches candidates, applies reported-quota admission, explains selections and records usage. The main agent receives each selection and dispatches through DSH's native subagent tool.
project_scope.objective_evidence: One paired translation-extension repair case completed. B failed a fixed quality requirement and took longer despite fewer GPT-routed tokens. Quality-preserving optimization and quota-budget adherence remain unproven.

problem_statement: Strong models available through a subscription have a finite usage allowance. High-allowance alternatives may not satisfy every task's quality requirements, while relying entirely on token-billed models creates additional API costs.
primary_objective: Reduce end-to-end completion time while meeting predefined output-quality requirements and keeping subscription usage within a declared allowance.

evaluation_plan.first_case: Repair translation-only layout in an existing browser translation extension on arXiv HTML.

application.routing_scope: Development subtasks; translation endpoint/model/parameters/prompts were required to remain unchanged.

arms.description: Pinned DeepSeek Harness version and default orchestration; record its actual provider and model configuration.
The same Harness version with the GeneralRouter adapter enabled; record all candidate configurations and routing decisions.

evaluation_plan.comparison_scope: Single-app engineering case study; repeated runs can assess variability, but do not establish general superiority.
evaluation_plan.baseline_disclosure: A omitted native model overrides and inherited Sol max. B explicitly dispatched Flash high through native subagent. Both host plugin tools were visible but unused in B; the native allowlist is not the host-wide candidate inventory.
fixed_conditions: Same original source and six input screenshots by protocol
Same task requirements, planner model, one actual development worker per arm and no separate reviewer
Same ten-minute intended development budget, with actual complete-turn overrun disclosed
No developer-run tests; user manually operated the delivered extensions
Translation endpoint/model/parameters/prompts required to remain unchanged
Sequential independent sessions; uncontrolled service load, cache state and runtime translation variation disclosed
record: Planner and worker usage including retries and routing overhead
Input, cached-input and output tokens where reported
Reasoning tokens as a disclosed component without double-counting
Observed subscription allowance consumption and reset windows
API-equivalent cost at dated model-specific rates
Routing decisions and any dispatched-model or effort fallback
evaluation_plan.subscription_allowance: Use observed allowance data, or identify an imposed experimental budget explicitly as a simulation. Do not infer an included token cap from a monthly fee.

cost_reporting.primary_comparison_metric: API-equivalent cost calculated from measured token usage, including subscription-backed calls.
cost_reporting.subscription: Measure allowance consumption separately; no task-level allocation of the monthly subscription fee is planned.
cost_reporting.api: Compute metered usage costs from recorded usage and a dated rate schedule; distinguish tariff-valued usage from cash paid.
cost_reporting.api_equivalent_cost: Sum uncached-input, cached-input and output tokens multiplied by their dated model-specific per-token API rates. Include planner, worker and retry calls. Preserve provider-specific usage semantics, count reasoning tokens once, and report unavailable usage or prices as unknown rather than zero.
cost_reporting.local_translation: Superseded by extension case; later manual translation requests excluded from development token accounting.

method_limits: The current four task anchors are regularized reference fits from four complete models on business-deliverable examples.
Sparse paired outcomes and correlated capability features limit identification of task weights.
Missing benchmark coverage does not by itself show that published benchmark scores are inaccurate.
No optimality or cross-domain predictive performance is established.

quota_integration_plan.status: Implemented; percentage snapshots observed in user runs. Per-task quota consumption and no-exhaustion guarantee remain unverified.
quota_integration_plan.strategy: Read credential/model metadata and reported applicable percentages directly from ECPA. No quota_group mapping, estimated per-task debit or settlement hold.
quota_integration_plan.refresh: Initial active read and then at most every ten minutes during activity; no idle refresh.
quota_integration_plan.unknown_data: Unreported or unscoped percentage stays unknown and does not itself block paid/API routes. Reported exhausted applicable allowance can exclude a route. No guarantee of never exhausting an account is established.

related_work_policy: Credit concrete papers or repositories and the specific ideas actually studied or adopted; do not infer institutional affiliation or fabricate prior influence.

workspace_configuration.configuration_scope: Machine-shared connection and host settings under $DSH_HOME/generalrouter (default ~/.dsh/generalrouter), optionally overridden by the active project.
workspace_configuration.skill_scope: The plugin provides its bundled planner skill through DSH across workspaces; a same-name project skill can override it.
workspace_configuration.record_scope: Tasks, usage, timing and quota-cache state belong to the current workspace. Shared configuration does not combine records from different workspaces.
workspace_configuration.switching_workspace: Start a new main session in the new workspace. No configuration or skill copying is required for the shared defaults.
workspace_configuration.unknown_connection: Matching may use bundled defaults without ECPA connection settings. Allowance remains unknown; this does not establish that enough allowance is available.
workspace_configuration.status: Installed and user-run observed in the default workspace; no exhaustive cross-workspace verification.

application.routing_scope: Cloud models carrying out app-development subtasks; the translation model used by the finished app remains identical in both arms.
application.local_runtime_and_quantization: To be selected and fixed identically for both arms.

superseded_evaluation_proposal.note: The proposed Hy-MT2 local app was replaced by the existing browser translation-extension repair case.
